concerns.text: FR-002 specifies a DistilledModel of 50 M parameters, but task T005 implements a 20 M‑parameter pruned DistilBERT, weakening the functional requirement on model capacity.

FR-005 requires evaluation of the augmented model on a held‑out scientific reasoning benchmark; task T009 permits skipping downstream evaluation if a verified dataset is unavailable, which effectively relaxes the required evaluation.
Success criterion SC-005 (total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) is not addressed by any verification step, leaving this acceptance criterion uncovered.
Success criterion SC-007 (validation‑loss‑to‑training‑loss ratio ≤ 2.0) is absent from all tasks, resulting in a dropped acceptance criterion.
